description: Turn off Claude Code's background requests you never see: next-prompt suggestions, session titles, away recaps, agent progress summaries and idle check-ins. Each one re-sends the conversation. Measured with a logging proxy: a 3-prompt chat went from 7 requests (~85K tokens) to 4 (~40K), same answers. Nothing changes what Claude is told or how it works. From claude-lean (https://github.com/JacobTheJacobs/claude-lean).
